hero.title: Personal AI Tarot readings in Telegram
hero.lead: Choose a spread, ask what matters to you, and receive the cards with a clear AI interpretation in your Telegram chat.
hero.imageAlt: A Tarot reader holding a glowing card above a spread

how.title: How the Tarot bot works
how.intro: Taroshenka guides you from choosing a spread to a complete interpretation without a separate app or another account.
steps: Start with a Daily Card, a quick one-card answer, a relationship reading, or a deeper layout.
Describe the situation in your own words. If an action uses credits, the bot shows the cost before confirmation.
See the drawn cards and read one connected AI interpretation shaped around the spread and your question.

readings.eyebrow: From quick guidance to deep reflection
readings.title: Tarot readings for different questions
readings.intro: Each format gives the cards a clear role, helping the interpretation connect individual meanings into a coherent view.
items: A daily card image and a short meaning for reflection.
A one-card symbolic perspective on a focused question.
A compact view of situation, movement and possible direction.
A five-card look at feelings, expectations and dynamics.
Four extended formats for questions that need more space.

ai.title: An interpretation shaped around your question
ai.text: The bot considers each card, its position, its upright or reversed orientation, and the context of your question before forming one readable interpretation.
ai.personal: You can save a name, birth date, zodiac sign, language and deck in your profile for a more personal tone. You can continue with a clarifying question or an additional card, and return to your reading history.

premium.title: More room for complex questions
premium.intro: Premium opens four extended readings and additional visual possibilities.
items: Compare option A and B while keeping the decision yours.
Reflect on resources, limits and possible actions without promising income.
A classic deep spread for a situation with many connected influences.
A month-by-month symbolic view of themes and possible accents.

credits.title: Credits and payment
credits.text: Credits are used for paid readings and additional actions. Packages of 5, 10 or 30 credits and a monthly Premium option are available. Premium adds 50 credits on activation and 50 credits after each successful monthly renewal.
credits.payment: For this language, payment is made with Telegram Stars. Current price, currency, payment method and subscription terms are shown in the bot before purchase.

languages.title: A Tarot bot in 20 languages
languages.text: The bot supports {count} languages. Telegram may set an initial language, and you can save or change it in your profile.
languages.names: English, Russian, Indonesian, Malay, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Uzbek, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, Belarusian, Ukrainian, Kazakh, Arabic, Persian, Korean and Hindi

faq: Taroshenka is an AI-powered Tarot reading bot in Telegram. You choose a spread, ask a question and receive card images with an interpretation in the chat.
No. Readings are for entertainment and self-reflection: they offer a symbolic perspective, not a guaranteed prediction.
The bot offers Daily Card, Yes or No, Three-card, Dawn, a five-card relationship reading and four Premium readings.
Premium includes Choice Between Two Options with 7 cards, Work & Finances with 7, Celtic Cross with 10 and Year Ahead with 12 cards.
Packages of 5, 10 or 30 credits and monthly Premium are available. The bot shows current terms before purchase.
The bot supports 20 languages listed above, with Arabic and Persian interfaces using right-to-left direction.

disclaimer.title: A note about Tarot
disclaimer.text: Tarot readings and AI interpretations are intended for entertainment and self-reflection. They are not a reliable prediction of the future and do not replace medical, psychological, legal, financial or other professional help. You make important decisions yourself.

cta.title: Ask the cards what matters to you
cta.text: Open the bot in Telegram, choose a spread and begin a reflective conversation.

daily-card.title: A daily Tarot card for reflection
daily-card.lead: Draw one card, see its image and receive a short symbolic meaning for the day.
daily-card.body: The Daily Card is a simple entry point into Tarot. Use it as a morning theme, a pause for reflection or a way to become familiar with card symbolism.
bullets: A gentle prompt rather than a prediction
daily-card.alt: A glowing Tarot card on a candlelit table

yes-no.title: A focused one-card Tarot reading
yes-no.lead: Ask a clear question and explore the card’s meaning in that specific context.
yes-no.body: The Yes or No format gives a short symbolic direction while explaining why the drawn card may carry that meaning for your question. It is a prompt for thinking, not a command or guarantee.
yes-no.alt: A single Tarot card beside a crystal

three-card.title: See a situation from three connected angles
three-card.lead: Use three cards to explore a situation, its movement and a possible direction.
three-card.body: The bot reads the cards together as well as individually, creating a connected interpretation for questions that need more context than a one-card reading.
three-card.alt: Three Tarot cards arranged in a reading spread

relationships.title: Reflect on relationship dynamics with five cards
relationships.lead: Explore feelings, expectations, obstacles and influences in a relationship-focused spread.
relationships.body: The five-card relationship reading offers a symbolic view of emotional dynamics. It does not claim to read another person’s mind or guarantee a particular outcome.
bullets: A reflective view of possible dynamics
relationships.alt: Five Tarot cards arranged beside a violet crystal
